first_use: authored public finite known-family DEV; no independent scientific acceptance
model_information_boundary: knowledge.py imports no world/evaluator/control; actual rule ID passed only to evaluator. Candidate snapshot contains task weights/confidence/action-use/fault only.
comparator_limits: same prior/active transcript for trained controls, same maximum actions for random policy; no total compute/capacity parity or superiority claimed
timer_scope: total_seconds covers complete assay. active/symbolic cover query selection and observe updates only, excluding initialization/cold/scoring; random covers3584 schedules, trained covers transcript fit. These arm timers must not be compared as matched end-to-end costs.
